text: The trouble with having an open mind, of course, is that people will insist on coming along and trying to put things in it.
author: Terry Pratchett
visual_brief: An engineering cross-section of a delicately balanced vessel with a hinged lid held slightly ajar, showing directional motion arrows tracking an influx of mismatched, angular geometric blocks crowding the opening. Crisp white technical linework on black, complete with pivot tolerances and dimension markings.
alt: Technical cross-section of a cracked-open vessel crowded by incoming geometric shapes.
